subject: PivotalOps integration: commercial split, SKU mapping & prospect anchor
messages:
From: Alice Chen <alice@pivotalops.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Partnership: Redwood runtime + PivotalOps connector — commercial ask

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — our engineering lead was impressed with the KV-cache optimizations and the Dedicated capacity options. PivotalOps is interested in embedding Redwood as the inference backend inside our Connector Suite (we'd surface Redwood as a managed option in our marketplace).

From a commercial standpoint we need a simple, predictable framework we can share with our customers and procurement. Can you provide:
- an initial revenue-split proposal for (a) referral/introduction, (b) reseller (we resell on invoice), and (c) co-sell integrations?
- draft MOU or term sheet we can circulate with our legal/procurement
- SKU mapping so we understand which Redwood SKUs (hosted/dedicated/private) map to our product tiers
- lead/intro protection rules (how long is a prospect anchored to the introducer; clawback windows)

I attached a short MOU template to start. Our procurement contact (Jennifer Li) will need the final countersigned terms + DocuSign link.

High level timeline: we are targeting a pilot in Q3 and GA by end of Q4. Happy to hop on a 30-min commercial + ops call next week.

Thanks,
Alice Chen
Head of Partnerships
PivotalOps
[Attachment: PivotalOps_MOU_draft.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.com <dylan_brooks@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@pivotalops.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Redwood runtime + PivotalOps connector — commercial ask

Hi Alice — great to connect. Appreciate the clear asks; below is a pragmatic set of options (we can refine once legal/ops chime in).

High-level commercial options (starter proposals):
1) Referral / Intro: 15% first-year revenue credit applied as a rebate to your customers' invoices. No direct support or invoicing by PivotalOps. 90-day intro anchor, 12-month clawback if the account churns within first year.
2) Reseller: PivotalOps invoices and remits net to Redwood. 40% gross margin share to PivotalOps on paid subscriptions or per-seat SKUs. Requires reseller agreement and invoicing cadence. 180-day anchor, 12-month clawback.
3) Co-sell (preferred for strategic accounts): 25% rev-share to PivotalOps with joint support SLA and joint commercial motion. For co-sell we recommend a co-marketing fund (one-time onboarding credit) to offset trial usage.

SKU mapping (attached) maps Redwood Hosted / Dedicated / Private to three PivotalOps product tiers (Starter/Business/Enterprise) — see SKU_Mapping.xlsx.

Operational notes / next steps:
- I'll loop in Marissa (legal/partner-ops) to produce a short MOU and finalize lead-registration windows.
- If procurement needs a DocuSign link, we can prepare an e-sign package once terms are agreed.
- Proposed next step: 30-min call with your procurement + engineering, our partner ops + legal next Tue or Wed.

I've attached a baseline term sheet for internal review.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SKU_Mapping.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Chen <alice@pivotalops.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com
Cc: camila_reyes@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Redwood runtime + PivotalOps connector — commercial ask

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 1:08 PM, dylan_brooks@redwood.com wrote:
> High-level commercial options (starter proposals):
> 1) Referral / Intro: 15% first-year revenue credit applied as a rebate to your customers' invoices. No direct support or invoicing by PivotalOps. 90-day intro anchor, 12-month clawback if the account churns within first year.
> 2) Reseller: PivotalOps invoices and remits net to Redwood. 40% gross margin share to PivotalOps on paid subscriptions or per-seat SKUs. Requires reseller agreement and invoicing cadence. 180-day anchor, 12-month clawback.
> 3) Co-sell (preferred for strategic accounts): 25% rev-share to PivotalOps with joint support SLA and joint commercial motion.

Thanks — looping Camila from partner-ops for operational intake. A few legal/ops clarifications and redlines to the draft MOU:
- Lead/Intro protection: we typically offer a 180-day anchor for reseller scenarios and 12 months for co-sell with documented lead registration via HubSpot/partner portal. For pure referral (no invoicing by partner) we can do 90 days. Please ensure registration includes prospect email/domain and source.
- Clawback: 12 months from first invoice for refunds/credits. We require signed SOW and first paid invoice to start the commission clock.
- Invoice routing: for reseller model we need a reseller billing addendum (net-30 default) + monthly remittance report.
- Tax & compliance: partners must provide W-9/Tax IDs and a primary billing contact.
- Trial credits & onboarding: recommend a one-time onboarding credit for pilots (applied to first invoice) and a joint marketing fund (co-op) for enterprise pushes — propose $10k co-op for the first year subject to 50/50 matching.

I've attached an annotated SKU mapping that calls out which Redwood product-level SKUs map to our billing primitives and the recommended revenue recognition path.

Please confirm Jennifer from procurement will accept DocuSign. Camila, can you add ops intake steps and a checklist for enablement (SAML provisioning, go-live playbook, alerting hooks)?

Marissa Cole
Director, Partner Operations & Legal | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SKU_Mapping_annotated.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Alice Chen <alice@pivotalops.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Jake Thornton <jake@pivotalops.com>, Jennifer Li <procurement@pivotalops.com>
Date: 2027-05-19T16:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Partnership: Redwood runtime + PivotalOps connector — commercial ask

Thanks Marissa and Dylan — this is helpful. Quick responses from our side:
- Procurement (Jennifer) confirms DocuSign is fine.
- We can accept the 180-day anchor for reseller and 12 months for co-sell. For referral we prefer a 120-day anchor — open to discussion.
- On revenue splits: for referrals we'd be comfortable at 10% first-year (we suggested 15% originally), for reseller/co-sell let's proceed with the co-sell model at 25% as a baseline.
- We agree the onboarding credit and joint marketing fund make sense; request a single-point contact at Redwood for campaign approvals.

Next steps:
1) Redwood to send a short MOU + reseller addendum with the anchor/clawback language and onboarding credit notes.
2) We will circulate internally; procurement will sign via DocuSign once terms finalized.
3) Schedule 30-min call next Wed to align ops (SAML, billing, SSO, logging hooks).

Looking forward — can you ping a calendar invite and include the HubSpot deal link?

Best,
Alice Chen
Head of Partnerships | PivotalOps
[Inline: Quoted previous emails]
summary: Commercial negotiation and ops intake for PivotalOps embedding Redwood. Key topics: referral/reseller/co-sell revenue splits, anchor/lead-registration windows, clawback terms, SKU mapping, onboarding credits and DocuSign procurement flow. Internal ops/legal (Marissa, Camila) to produce MOU and enablement checklist.
